row.title: OL-20261112-93: a CLI sign-in counts as a credential only on a server-side host
row.body: foundation/ladder.py cli_scope and Boot._gh_admin_org (seed and workers copies) accept an existing gh sign-in only when CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE or GITHUB_ACTIONS is set. doctrine/server-side.json bans the old wording (id signed-in-cli) and no longer excludes demos/public/cases.json, whose two lines now cite the rule.

title: OL-20261112-93: a CLI sign-in counts as a credential only on a server-side host
